title: Procedural Tiled PBR Material Swatches
asset_license: MIT; original seeded procedural texture graphs and meshes; no third-party bytes
visual_specification: Exact 900x560 five-swatch PBR board using seeded Perlin, Worley, brick, checker and radial ramps; each material bakes albedo, linear ORM and height-derived normal relief with trilinear filtering and saves an .lmmat pack.
